requirements.title: MASKL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer, nonnegative, and no greater than the number of bits z of the integer bit model for the result kind; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.MASKL-I-integer: Positive source control calls MASKL with integer I values 0, 1, 3, and BIT_SIZE(0); a source-control mutation uses a noninteger I and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MASKL-I-nonnegative-and-at-most-z: Positive source controls call MASKL with I=0, I=1, and I=BIT_SIZE(0); source-control mutations use I=-1 and I=BIT_SIZE(0)+1 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MASKL-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expre: Positive source control calls MASKL with KIND=KIND(0); source-control mutations use a noninteger or nonconstant KIND expression and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MASKL result type and kind follow KIND presence or default integer
requirements.definition: The MASKL result is integer; with KIND present its kind type parameter is the value of KIND, and with KIND absent its kind type parameter is default integer.

pending.MASKL-result-integer-type: Assign MASKL(1) to an integer variable and assert POPCNT plus BTEST bit observations from the bit-result facet; mutate the intrinsic to a logical-valued control in source review, not as a diagnostic facet.
pending.MASKL-result-kind-from-KIND: Guarded plan probes for a nondefault integer kind via SELECTED_INT_KIND; after availability is established, evaluate MASKL(1,KIND=that_kind), assert KIND(...) equals that kind, and mutate KIND to KIND(0) so the kind check fails. The default-kind control exercises KIND presence without claiming nondefault coverage on processors lacking another kind.
pending.MASKL-result-default-kind-absent: Evaluate MASKL(1) and assert KIND(...) equals KIND(0); companion MASKL(1,KIND=KIND(0)) guards against an absent-call parser special case.

requirements.title: MASKL sets the leftmost I bits in bit context
requirements.definition: The MASKL result has its leftmost I bits set to 1 and all remaining bits set to 0 under the 16.3 integer bit model.

pending.MASKL-zero-left-bits-all-zero: Use I=0 with a nonvacuous I=1 companion; assert POPCNT(MASKL(0))==0 and POPCNT(MASKL(1))==1, never the numeric value of a sign-bit result. Mutate I=0 to I=1 so the zero-width case fails.
pending.MASKL-leftmost-I-bits-set: For z=BIT_SIZE(0), compute R=MASKL(3), assert BTEST(R,z-1), BTEST(R,z-2), and BTEST(R,z-3) are true and POPCNT(R)==3; mutate MASKL to MASKR so the leftmost-bit checks fail.
pending.MASKL-remaining-bits-zero: For R=MASKL(3), assert BTEST(R,0) and BTEST(R,z-4) are false for z greater than 3, paired with the three true leftmost checks; mutate I to z so the remaining-bit checks fail.
pending.MASKL-full-width-all-bits-set: Use I=BIT_SIZE(0), assert POPCNT(MASKL(I))==I plus BTEST at positions 0 and I-1 are true, and compare only bit-context observations; mutate I to I-1 so one selected bit or count check fails.
